INSERT INTO crm_user_mappings (
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            provider,
            crm_tenant_id,
            crm_principal_id,
            source,
            last_verified_at
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3::text::crm_provider, $4, $5, 'EMAIL_MATCH', COALESCE($6, now()))
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id, provider, crm_tenant_id)
         DO UPDATE
            SET crm_principal_id = EXCLUDED.crm_principal_id,
                source = 'EMAIL_MATCH'::crm_user_mapping_source,
                last_verified_at = EXCLUDED.last_verified_at,
                updated_at = now()
         WHERE crm_user_mappings.source = 'EMAIL_MATCH'::crm_user_mapping_source
         RETURNING id
